He also authored several significant works, including "Hortus Cliffortianus," "Flora Lapponica," "Fauna Svecica," and "Centuria Insectorum." His contributions to science earned him recognition as one of the top 100 historical figures on Wikipedia.

Her works include "Frankenstein," "Political Justice," "Lives of the most Eminent Literary and Scientific Men," "The Last Man," "Matilda," "The Monster," and many others.
